subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Follow suit
solution:
The correct answer is **"do the same as others"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "**conform to another's actions.**"
 
• We use the given idiom when we are telling a person to follow someone's actions.
 
 
• **Example**:* The businessmen's daughter **follows suit __**by taking over the company after his retirement.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "**दूसरे के कार्यों के अनुरूप**।"
